citations.quote: The CMR will apply to an RA 13 licensed corporation (LC) and its associated entity (AE) in respect of “scheme money” received or held in Hong Kong by the RA 13 LC or its AE in the course of conducting Type 13 regulated activity by the RA 13 LC, only when such LC is not acting as a Transfer Agent.

readings.distinction: The sentence-level attachment restricts the entire coordinated LC-and-AE application statement. “Not” negates acting as a Transfer Agent; it does not negate “only when” or either receipt/holding alternative. This is the most direct surface parse, although the extent of the LC’s acting status remains context-sensitive.

citations.quote: Would activities that an RA 13 depositary performs in its capacity as a Transfer Agent (TA) (eg, processing payments in designated accounts) be subject to requirements under the CMR?
only when such LC is not acting as a Transfer Agent.

In such cases, the depositary is expected to observe relevant requirements under Schedule 11 to the Code of Conduct for Persons Licensed by or Registered with the Securities and Futures Commission (Schedule 11), in particular paragraphs 9 (relating to how subscription and redemption proceeds should be held) and 11 (relating to distribution proceeds).

readings.distinction: The negation still attaches to acting as a Transfer Agent, but the question narrows that activity to the particular handling under assessment. This contextual reading is preferable for a mixed-capacity LC because Q1 expressly asks about activities performed in its TA capacity. The answer’s reference to “such LC” nevertheless leaves the broader reading defensible.
questions: Is transfer_agent indexed to the particular funds and handling activity? Its supplied definition does not specify that relationship.

If transfer_agent records general acting status, what permitted fact can distinguish TA handling of these funds from simultaneous TA work involving other funds? Without that distinction this reading cannot be encoded faithfully using the unchanged vocabulary.

vocabulary_concerns: transfer_agent lacks an explicit funds, activity or time index. The fixed vocabulary cannot distinguish general LC acting status from its capacity in the particular handling without an additional interpretation assumption.

The vocabulary contains no Schedule 11 duty predicates. Failure of the selected antecedent therefore cannot establish absence of continuing duties, and the source does not expressly settle whether Q1’s “In such cases” includes every TA exclusion.
The incorporated definitions and missing dependency are not supplied. scheme_money and ra13_context remain external classifications rather than independently verified legal conclusions.
A Boolean antecedent cannot itself express the distinction between “only when” as a necessary condition and a complete sufficient rule for legal applicability.
